subject.title: fix(web-fetch): extract full HTML body content

question: Should title-only Readability output preserve the documented provider-before-basic-cleanup fallback order, even though that can call configured providers for pages that previously returned locally?
rationale: The code is a plausible runtime fix, but the fallback order is an existing user/provider behavior contract with latency, output, and provider-usage implications that automation should not silently choose.

options.title: Land provider-first title-only fallback
options.body: Land this shape if maintainers want title-only Readability to be treated as incomplete while preserving the documented provider-before-basic cleanup order.

options.title: Switch title-only fallback to local-first
options.body: Ask for a small code/test adjustment if maintainers prefer avoiding provider calls before local body cleanup for this specific title-only failure mode.

options.title: Pause for exact-page proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a live failing URL or equivalent reporter fixture proves the exact provider/local ordering needed for the user case.

recommendation.title: Land provider-first title-only fallback
recommendation.body: Land this shape if maintainers want title-only Readability to be treated as incomplete while preserving the documented provider-before-basic cleanup order.
